title: The Last Confession Revisited
author: Kestrel Eastwick
blurb: Casper Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
